summary.text: Itsekiri tradition remembers Ginuwa, a prince of Benin, leading a party down the creeks to found the kingdom of Warri among the Itsekiri. Its Olus trace their line to him.

routes.label: Ginuwa’s party goes down the creeks from Benin

moments.title: Ode-Itsekiri
moments.text: The new kingdom’s seat, Ode-Itsekiri (Big Warri), is founded.
